```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
input_path <- "~/Objective_3/Objective_3_motifs_analysis/data/all_motifs_concat.tsv"

df <- read.delim(input_path, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Drop rows with no motif called
df <- df %>% filter(Motif != "No Motif Assigned")

n_isolates <- n_distinct(df$sample)
n_isolates
```

```{r}
#| label: exact-match
motif_isolate_counts <- df %>%
  distinct(sample, Motif) %>%
  count(Motif, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates))

common_exact <- motif_isolate_counts %>%
  filter(n_isolates == n_distinct(df$sample))

cat("Motifs present in every isolate (exact match):\n")
print(common_exact)
```

```{r}
#| label: exact-match-freq
cat("Motif frequency across isolates (top 20, exact match):\n")
print(head(motif_isolate_counts, 20))
```

```{r}
#| label: iupac-functions
iupac_comp <- c(A = "T", T = "A", C = "G", G = "C", N = "N",
                 R = "Y", Y = "R", S = "S", W = "W", K = "M", M = "K",
                 B = "V", V = "B", D = "H", H = "D")

revcomp <- function(s) {
  chars <- strsplit(s, "")[[1]]
  paste(rev(iupac_comp[chars]), collapse = "")
}

iupac_sets <- list(
  A = c("A"), C = c("C"), G = c("G"), T = c("T"),
  R = c("A", "G"), Y = c("C", "T"), S = c("G", "C"), W = c("A", "T"),
  K = c("G", "T"), M = c("A", "C"),
  B = c("C", "G", "T"), D = c("A", "G", "T"), H = c("A", "C", "T"), V = c("A", "C", "G"),
  N = c("A", "C", "G", "T")
)

iupac_compatible <- function(a, b) {
  if (nchar(a) != nchar(b)) return(FALSE)
  ac <- strsplit(a, "")[[1]]
  bc <- strsplit(b, "")[[1]]
  all(mapply(function(x, y) length(intersect(iupac_sets[[x]], iupac_sets[[y]])) > 0, ac, bc))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cluster-motifs
motifs <- unique(df$Motif)
n_m <- length(motifs)
cluster_id <- setNames(seq_len(n_m), motifs)

merge_clusters <- function(cid, i, j) {
  old <- cid[j]
  new <- cid[i]
  cid[cid == old] <- new
  cid
}

for (i in seq_len(n_m)) {
  for (j in seq_len(n_m)) {
    if (i >= j) next
    m1 <- motifs[i]
    m2 <- motifs[j]
    same <- iupac_compatible(m1, m2) ||
      (nchar(m1) == nchar(m2) && iupac_compatible(m1, revcomp(m2)))
    if (same) cluster_id <- merge_clusters(cluster_id, i, j)
  }
}

motif_family <- tibble(Motif = motifs, family_id = cluster_id[motifs]) %>%
  group_by(family_id) %>%
  mutate(
    family_label = paste(sort(unique(Motif)), collapse = " / "),
    family_short = paste0(min(Motif), " (+", n() - 1, " variants)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_fam <- df %>%
  left_join(motif_family %>% select(Motif, family_id, family_label, family_short),
            by = "Motif")
```

```{r}
#| label: family-collapse-summary
n_raw_motifs <- n_distinct(df$Motif)
n_families <- n_distinct(motif_family$family_label)

cat(sprintf("Raw distinct motifs (exact string):        %d\n", n_raw_motifs))
cat(sprintf("Collapsed motif families (IUPAC + RC aware): %d\n", n_families))
cat(sprintf("Reduction: %d motifs merged into %d families (%.1f%% fewer)\n",
            n_raw_motifs - n_families, n_families,
            100 * (1 - n_families / n_raw_motifs)))
```

```{r}
#| label: family-collapse-detail
family_sizes <- motif_family %>%
  group_by(family_label) %>%
  summarise(n_raw_variants = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_raw_variants))

cat("Motif families ranked by how many raw motif strings were merged into them:\n")
print(family_sizes, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: family-freq

cat("Motif families (IUPAC + reverse-complement aware) by isolate count:\n")
print(family_isolate_counts, n = Inf)
```

```{r}

common_families <- family_isolate_counts %>%
```

```{r}
#| label: load-metadata
metadata <- read.csv("~/Objective_3/Objective_3_motifs_analysis/data/metadata_Apr26.csv")

metadata <- metadata %>% rename(sample = Isolate_ID)
```

```{r}
#| label: join-metadata
df_fam <- df_fam %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")

# sanity check: any isolates in the motif data with no metadata match?
cat("Isolates missing metadata:\n")
print(setdiff(unique(df_fam$sample), unique(metadata$sample)))
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-group-sizes
sbi_sizes <- metadata %>%
  count(SBI, name = "n_isolates_in_group") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates_in_group))

cat("Isolates per SBI group:\n")
print(sbi_sizes, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-motif-presence
# Uses family_short (short label) as the grouping key for motif family,
# since family_label can be very long for large IUPAC/RC-merged clusters
family_sbi_presence <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_short, SBI) %>%
  count(family_short, SBI, name = "n_isolates_with_motif") %>%
  left_join(sbi_sizes, by = "SBI") %>%
  mutate(prop_in_group = n_isolates_with_motif / n_isolates_in_group)

cat("Motif family presence by SBI group:\n")
print(family_sbi_presence, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-specific-motifs
family_sbi_groups <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  group_by(family_short) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sbi_groups_present = n_distinct(SBI),
    sbi_groups = paste(sort(unique(SBI)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sbi_specific <- family_sbi_groups %>%
  filter(n_sbi_groups_present == 1)

cat("Motif families found in only ONE SBI group (SBI-specific):\n")
print(sbi_specific, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-specific-core
sbi_specific_core <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  semi_join(sbi_specific, by = "family_short") %>%
  filter(prop_in_group == 1)

cat("SBI-specific motifs that are also core (100%) within that group:\n")
print(sbi_specific_core, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: sbi-shared-motifs
```


```{r}
#| label: motif-matrix
# Isolate x motif-family presence/absence matrix (for PCoA)
motif_matrix <- df_fam %>%
  distinct(sample, family_label) %>%
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = family_label, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

motif_mat <- as.matrix(motif_matrix %>% select(-sample))
rownames(motif_mat) <- motif_matrix$sample

dim(motif_mat)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-distance
motif_dist <- vegdist(motif_mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-run
pcoa_res <- pcoa(motif_dist)

eig_pct <- round(100 * pcoa_res$values$Relative_eig[1:5], 1)
cat("Variance explained by first 5 axes (%):\n")
print(eig_pct)
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot-data
pcoa_scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$vectors[, 1:2])
colnames(pcoa_scores) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
pcoa_scores$sample <- rownames(pcoa_scores)

pcoa_scores <- pcoa_scores %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample")
```

```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot
ggplot(pcoa_scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = SBI)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),
    title = "PCoA of isolates based on RM motif family presence/absence",
    color = "SBI"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot-farmt
pcoa_scores$Farm_id <- factor(
  pcoa_scores$Farm_id,
  levels = c(19, 25, 30, 84, 130),
  labels = c("19", "25", "30", "84", "130")
)

ggplot(pcoa_scores, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = Farm_id)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),

```


```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-presence-absence
motif_sbi_heatmap_data <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  mutate(n_isolates_without_motif = n_isolates_in_group - n_isolates_with_motif) %>%
  select(family_short, SBI, n_isolates_in_group,
         n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_isolates_with_motif, n_isolates_without_motif),
    names_to = "status",
    values_to = "n_isolates"
  ) %>%
  mutate(status = recode(status,
                          n_isolates_with_motif = "Present",
                          n_isolates_without_motif = "Absent"))
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-refine
# Drop the two universal motifs (all-present, zero variability, uninformative here)
uninformative <- c("GATC (+0 variants)", "CCTGG (+1 variants)")

# Order rows by how variable presence is across SBI groups —
# most differentiating motifs at the top
row_order <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  group_by(family_short) %>%
  summarise(variability = sd(prop_in_group), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(variability)) %>%
  pull(family_short)

motif_sbi_heatmap_data_refined <- motif_sbi_heatmap_data %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  mutate(family_short = factor(family_short, levels = rev(row_order)))
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-save-refined
p <- ggplot(motif_sbi_heatmap_data_refined, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = n_isolates)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n_isolates), size = 2.8) +
  facet_wrap(~status) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Isolates",
    title = "Isolates with vs without each motif family, by SBI group",
    subtitle = "Rows ordered by variability in presence across SBI groups (most differentiating at top)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave("motif_sbi_heatmap_refined.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 13, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-heatmap-pct-patchwork
motif_sbi_pct_data <- family_sbi_presence %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_present = 100 * prop_in_group,
    family_short = factor(family_short, levels = rev(row_order))
  )

# Top panel: group sizes, plain (no fill scale)
p_n <- ggplot(sbi_sizes, aes(x = SBI, y = 1, label = n_isolates_in_group)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "grey90", color = "white") +
  geom_text(size = 3) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(b = 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1, labels = "N isolates")

# Bottom panel: the percentage heatmap
p_heat <- ggplot(motif_sbi_pct_data, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = pct_present)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pct_present)), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "% isolates\nwith motif"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 0))

p_combined <- p_n / p_heat +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 30)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Percentage of isolates carrying each motif family, by SBI group",
    subtitle = "Rows ordered by variability in presence across SBI groups (most differentiating at top)"
  )

ggsave("motif_sbi_heatmap_pct_patchwork.png", plot = p_combined, width = 10, height = 13, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-missing
check_family <- function(label) {
  present <- df_fam %>% filter(family_label == label) %>% pull(sample) %>% unique()
  all_samples <- unique(df$sample)
  setdiff(all_samples, present)
}

# Example — replace with a family_label string from the table above:
```

```{r}
#| label: hclust-motifs
motif_hclust <- hclust(motif_dist, method = "average")

plot(motif_hclust, labels = rownames(motif_mat), cex = 0.6,
     main = "Hierarchical clustering of isolates (Jaccard distance on motif families)",
     xlab = "", sub = "")
```



```{r}
#| label: choose-k-silhouette
library(cluster)

sil_widths <- sapply(2:10, function(k) {
  clusters_k <- cutree(motif_hclust, k = k)
  ss <- silhouette(clusters_k, motif_dist)
  mean(ss[, 3])
})

sil_df <- tibble(k = 2:10, avg_silhouette = sil_widths)

cat("Average silhouette width by number of clusters:\n")
print(sil_df)

ggplot(sil_df, aes(x = k, y = avg_silhouette)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:10) +
  labs(x = "Number of clusters (k)", y = "Average silhouette width",
       title = "Choosing k for motif-based clustering") +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
#| label: cut-clusters
# Pick k based on the silhouette plot above — replace 4 with whatever
# looks best (highest avg_silhouette, or an elbow)
k_chosen <- sil_df$k[which.max(sil_df$avg_silhouette)]
cat("Chosen k (highest silhouette):", k_chosen, "\n")

cluster_assignments <- tibble(
  sample = rownames(motif_mat),
  motif_cluster = factor(cutree(motif_hclust, k = k_chosen))
)

cluster_assignments <- cluster_assignments %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
  arrange(motif_cluster, SBI)

cat("Isolate cluster assignments:\n")
print(cluster_assignments %>% select(sample, SBI, motif_cluster), n = Inf)
```


```{r}
#| label: cluster-vs-sbi
# Cross-tab: how well do motif-based clusters line up with SBI groups?
cluster_sbi_table <- table(cluster_assignments$motif_cluster, cluster_assignments$SBI)

cat("Motif cluster vs SBI group cross-tabulation:\n")
print(cluster_sbi_table)
```


```{r}
#| label: pcoa-plot-clusters
pcoa_scores_clustered <- pcoa_scores %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments %>% select(sample, motif_cluster), by = "sample")

ggplot(pcoa_scores_clustered, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, color = motif_cluster, shape = SBI)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, width = 0.01, height = 0.01) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", eig_pct[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", eig_pct[2], "%)"),
    title = "PCoA colored by motif-based cluster, shaped by SBI group",
    color = "Motif cluster",
    shape = "SBI"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-site-stats
# Aggregate to family level per isolate first (sum counts across any
# raw motifs merged into the same family within a single isolate),
# then join SBI and average within each family x SBI group
motif_isolate_family_stats <- df_fam %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genome_sites)) %>%
  group_by(sample, family_short, SBI) %>%
  summarise(
    Genome_sites = sum(Genome_sites),
    Methylated_sites = sum(Methylated_sites),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct_methylated = 100 * Methylated_sites / Genome_sites)

family_sbi_site_stats <- motif_isolate_family_stats %>%
  filter(!family_short %in% uninformative) %>%
  group_by(family_short, SBI) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_genome_sites = mean(Genome_sites),
    mean_methylated_sites = mean(Methylated_sites),
    mean_pct_methylated = mean(pct_methylated),
    n_isolates_with_data = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(family_short = factor(family_short, levels = rev(row_order)))

cat("Average genome sites / methylated sites / % methylation, by motif family and SBI group:\n")
print(family_sbi_site_stats, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-site-heatmap-long
site_heatmap_long <- family_sbi_site_stats %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_genome_sites, mean_methylated_sites, mean_pct_methylated),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric = recode(metric,
                          mean_genome_sites = "Mean genome sites",
                          mean_methylated_sites = "Mean methylated sites",
                          mean_pct_methylated = "Mean % methylated"),
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("Mean genome sites",
                                             "Mean methylated sites",
                                             "Mean % methylated")))
```


```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-site-heatmap-save
p <- ggplot(site_heatmap_long, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 1)), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Value",
    title = "Genome sites, methylated sites, and % methylation by motif family and SBI group",
    subtitle = "Averaged across isolates carrying each motif; rows ordered as in the presence/absence heatmap"
  ) +

        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave("motif_sbi_site_stats_heatmap.png", plot = p, width = 15, height = 13, dpi = 300)#| label: motif-sbi-site-heatmap-save
p <- ggplot(site_heatmap_long, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(value, 1)), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    x = "SBI group",
    y = "Motif family",
    fill = "Value",
    title = "Genome sites, methylated sites, and % methylation by motif family and SBI group",
    subtitle = "Averaged across isolates carrying each motif; rows ordered as in the presence/absence heatmap"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

ggsave("motif_sbi_site_stats_heatmap.png", plot = p, width = 15, height = 13, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: motif-sbi-site-heatmap-patchwork
p_genome <- ggplot(family_sbi_site_stats, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = mean_genome_sites)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_genome_sites)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkorange") +
  labs(x = "SBI group", y = "Motif family", fill = "Mean\ngenome sites",
       title = "Genome sites") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

p_methylated <- ggplot(family_sbi_site_stats, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = mean_methylated_sites)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_methylated_sites)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkorange") +
  labs(x = "SBI group", y = NULL, fill = "Mean\nmethylated\nsites",
       title = "Methylated sites") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

p_pct <- ggplot(family_sbi_site_stats, aes(x = SBI, y = family_short, fill = mean_pct_methylated)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_pct_methylated, 1)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "dodgerblue", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "SBI group", y = NULL, fill = "Mean %\nmethylated",
       title = "% methylated") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank())

p_combined <- p_genome + p_methylated + p_pct +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, 1.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Genome sites, methylated sites, and % methylation by motif family and SBI group",
    subtitle = "Averaged across isolates carrying each motif; rows ordered as in the presence/absence heatmap"
  )

ggsave("motif_sbi_site_stats_heatmap_patchwork.png", plot = p_combined, width = 18, height = 13, dpi = 300)
```
